## 2. Session 1 (2026-10-28): AI visual teaching

### AI visual teaching (Phase 5): implemented and verified end to end

**Pipeline:** learner names a topic or picks their own material → `POST /api/v1/learning/generate` with `kind: visual_lesson` → AI service `POST /api/v1/learn/generate` → structured lesson → stored as a `learning_resources` row → `/learn/resources/:id` renders it through the renderer registry → the learner steps through, rotates 3D models, switches to 2D, asks the tutor (`POST /ai-tutor/explain`) and finishes (`POST /learning/resources/:id/complete`, which counts towards the streak).

**Visual registry v1.** A closed set: AI output is **data**, never code.

| Type | Use | View |
|---|---|---|
| `shape3d` | geometry solids with labelled dimensions | 3D |
| `molecule` | atoms and bonds; deterministic layout computed by the frontend | 3D |
| `vectors` | forces and velocities, with optional resultant | 3D |
| `orbit` | orbits, electron shells | 3D |
| `wave` | travelling waves (instanced particles) | 3D |
| `graph2d` | fixed function families `y = a·f(bx+c)+d`, sampled in code with no `eval` | SVG |
| `flow` | processes and cycles | SVG |
| `labeled` | structures and their parts | 2D |

**Safety.** The lesson is validated three times: in the AI service (`visual_spec.py`), the backend (`src/learning/visual-lesson.ts`) and the frontend (`src/lib/visual-lesson.ts`).

- Unknown types and fields are dropped and numbers clamped; elements must be on an allowlist.
- No URLs, markup, scripts or expressions survive.
- A step whose visual is invalid keeps its text.

**Topic lessons.** A learner can name a topic with no material (`sourceType: 'topic'`, visual lessons only).

- The lesson is labelled "AI-generated from general knowledge". That label is set by the **backend** from the request, never taken from the AI.
- Other kinds still require material.

**Performance and accessibility:**

- the 3D scene is lazy-loaded and client-only (`next/dynamic`, `ssr: false`);
- only the current step's canvas is mounted, so there is one WebGL context, and switching to 2D releases it;
- there is a WebGL capability check;
- an error boundary falls back to 2D;
- with `prefers-reduced-motion`, nothing animates (`frameloop: 'demand'`);
- every visual has a screen-reader description and labels are plain text;
- the AI tutor endpoint is throttled to 1 request per 3 s and 8 per minute per learner.

**Not supported, and not claimed:**

- arbitrary AI-generated 3D models, Blender or GLB assets, or video. The repository contains no GLB/GLTF assets, and GSAP is not installed;
- real-time voice inside lessons.

Adding curated GLB models would need an asset library and a `model` visual type that references assets by an allowlisted id. That is separate work.

**Contract fixes found while doing this:**

- The frontend's `AiTutorExplainPayload` sent `concept`, but the backend DTO requires `input`.
- The AI service's `TutorPayload.context` is a dict; a string context gave a 422, which surfaced to the learner as "AI generation failed".
- Generating a quiz *from* a visual lesson would have sent its JSON as source text. The backend now flattens it to prose (`visualLessonText`).

**Inventory tool:** `scripts/integration-inventory.mjs` (read-only) builds the matrix.

## 3. Session 2 (2026-10-29): Practice & exams, learning intelligence, gamification

### Security and correctness fixes (found while integrating)

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| **Question bank:** `POST/PATCH/DELETE /questions` needed only a learner login, so any learner could create, edit or **delete** shared questions | Mutations are now `@AdminOnly(content.manage)`; reads stay learner-accessible. Spec: `src/questions/questions.controller.spec.ts` |
| **Analytics returned fabricated data:** `GET /analytics/mastery` was a hard-coded **78.5%**; courses, topics, weak and strong topics returned fixed placeholder text; nothing wrote `user_performances`, so every figure was 0 | Graded submissions now record performance rows (`src/analytics/record-performance.ts`). Topics, mastery and weak/strong topics come from stored attempt reviews (`src/analytics/topic-stats.ts`). Empty or `null` with no data |
| **Scoped leaderboards were fake:** school/university/department compared a non-existent `school` field, so with no name they returned **everyone**; `course` ignored the course; `friends` returned the global top 10 | Real profile fields (`secondarySchool`, `university`, `department`), case-insensitive, falling back to the learner's own value. `course` ranks enrolled learners only. `friends` answers 501, since there are no friend connections |
| Recommendations for topics, quizzes, revision, exams and the summary were 501 (they used to proxy to an AI that invented catalogue items) | Computed from the learner's own records, each with its real reason (`src/recommendations/learning-recommendations.ts`) |
| Study-plan generation was 501 (it once saved two fixed fake sessions) | Deterministic scheduler from the learner's own course modules or exam subjects plus weak topics (`src/planner/plan-generator.ts`). Regenerating replaces only that target's open generated sessions |
| Calendar was 501 everywhere: its Prisma model never had a table | Moved to TypeORM with a migration (below) |
| Official quiz/test/exam attempts were graded but never stored: start, results, history, readiness and simulate answered 501 | Stored attempts (`src/official-attempts/`) with a migration (below). Submit keeps its contract and still works if the table is absent |

### New migrations (tested locally only; NOT run on production)

| File | Creates | Tested |
|---|---|---|
| `database/migrations/20261028210252_official_assessment_attempts.sql` | `official_assessment_attempts`: owner, kind, assessment, answers, score, per-question review, deadline; a partial unique index allows one open attempt | Applied to the local `gleamlearn_e2e`; browser suite `practice-exams` |
| `database/migrations/20261028230000_calendar_events.sql` | `calendar_events` (snake_case, as the old Prisma model); a CHECK that an event doesn't end before it starts | Applied to the local `gleamlearn_e2e`; browser suite `intelligence`; specs |

Both are additive and fail loudly if the table already exists. Production order after approval: first `baseline` the existing eight tables (`20261028000000`), then `run` for these two. See `mycoursea-backend/database/README.md`.

### Batches 6–7 (2026-10-29): support, usage, settings, goals, library edits, course leaderboard

More problems found and fixed while integrating:

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| **Reports and feedback answered 501** (Prisma models with no table), so Help & Support could only open an email | Reports are stored in the existing `admin_reports` table, the one the admin moderation routes (`/admin/reports`) already list, resolve and reject. Feedback gets a new `learner_feedback` table (migration below). Learners see their reports and the moderators' decision |
| **Usage limits reported invented caps** (10 AI requests a day, 20 quizzes, 5 documents) that nothing enforced, read from Prisma tables that never existed (always 501) | `GET /usage` reports real counts against the limits the server actually enforces: 200 uploaded materials, 50 personal courses. Daily AI and quiz use is counted (midnight WAT) but is not capped, and the response says `limit: null` |
| **`PATCH /users/me/notification-preferences` and `/privacy-settings` echoed the body back as "updated successfully" without saving anything** | Notification preferences are stored through the real notification settings (validated booleans). Privacy has no storage and nothing would enforce it, so it answers **501** |
| **Goal progress could not be recorded.** `PATCH /goals/:id` didn't accept `currentValue`, so a goal was only ever 0% or completed | `currentValue` is accepted (0 to 1,000,000), kept within the target; reaching the target completes the goal and lowering it reopens it. A target of 0 or less is refused. Title and description are length-capped |
| **Scoped leaderboards filtered *after* taking the global top 50**, so a learner outside it never appeared on their own school, university, department, country or course board | The filters now run in SQL before the limit, with a whitelist of profile columns. Verified live: a course board ranks exactly its two enrolled learners |

New migration (tested locally only; **not** run on production):

| File | Creates | Tested |
|---|---|---|
| `database/migrations/20261029090000_learner_feedback.sql` | `learner_feedback` (owner, rating CHECK 1–5, message CHECK 1–4000 characters) | All four migrations applied through the hardened runner to a fresh scratch local database (then dropped): 4 applied, 0 pending. Applied to `gleamlearn_e2e`. The constraints reject a rating of 6 and an empty message |

- **Covered by an equivalent wired route** (no separate screen needed):

  - `streak/history`, `streak/recovery` (`streak/summary`, `streak/calendar`);
  - `planner/today|week|month` (`/planner`, grouped in the UI);
  - `calendar`, `calendar/week`, `calendar/day` (`calendar/month`);

- **Server-only, never a screen:**

## 5. How to resume (next exact steps)

1. **Start the local stack:**
   - `mock_nim.py`, `smtp_sink.py`, `start-ai-service.mjs <ai repo>`, `E2E_SYNC=false start-backend.mjs` (after `npx nest build`);
   - frontend: `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5055/api/v1 npx next build && npx next start -p 3917`.
2. **If `gleamlearn_e2e` was recreated,** apply both new migrations to it: `node test/live/apply-sql.mjs database/migrations/<file>` (this refuses non-local hosts).
3. **Seed the fixtures:**
   - `node test/live/seed-assessments.mjs` → `SEED`;
   - `node test/live/seed-past-questions.mjs` → `PQ_SUBJECT`.
4. **Run the browser suites:** `practice-exams` (`SEED`, `PQ_SUBJECT`), `intelligence` (`SEED`), `visual-lesson`, `self-learning`.
5. **Done in batches 6–7:** reports, feedback, usage, settings, goals, library edits, academic pickers, course leaderboard. New suites: `support-usage` (`PQ_SUBJECT`, admin credentials) and `settings-library` (`SEED`, admin credentials). Admin credentials come from the backend `.env` (`SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL`/`PASSWORD`, local only) via the `ADMIN_EMAIL`/`ADMIN_PASSWORD` environment variables; never print them.
   Batches 8–9 done (navigation, School directory, Feedback, honest admin metrics). **Next batch:** admin users (11 routes), audit logs (2) and activity (6) after reviewing each service, then roles and permissions (8), then a gamification page on the now-real `/admin/gamification/*`.
6. **Then:**
   - tutor sessions and voice;
   - the navigation regrouping;
   - the admin console module by module (`src/app/admin/(console)`).
7. **After each batch:** regenerate the matrix and update this report.
8. **Afterwards:** run a normal `npx next build`, so `.next` isn't left pointing at the local API.

Another 59 are covered by an equivalent wired route (for example `/usage/ai` through `/usage`, `/calendar/week` through `/calendar/month`) or are called through a path the detector can't see (`/analytics/overview`, `/past-questions`, `/questions`). The bare `/search/*` routes are covered by `search/everything` |
| **Partially integrated** | **25** | The module works in the app but these capabilities don't yet: tutor question/answer and drawing (3), voice (3, two are 501 by design), `POST ai/conversations`, `DELETE ai-companion`, public profiles (3, held for the privacy decision), privacy settings (501), `achievements/:id`, catalogue search and topic pages (3), library favourites (2), lesson progress update and history (2), push tokens (2, web push not configured), `content/:id/report`, `coins/spend`, and the friends board (501, no friend connections) |
| **Unintegrated** | **174** | 131 admin routes (see §4: 26 are honest 501s and 7 are the silo). 36 superseded legacy learner routes: `ai/documents/*` (14), `quizzes/tests/exams/generate*` (9), legacy `youtube/*` (7) and `files/*` (6), all replaced by the self-service flows and **awaiting your decision to retire**. 7 subscription and payment routes, **contained by design** |
| **Intentionally server-only** | **9** | `GET /`, `health/*` (4), `storage/local/:p`, `payments/webhook`, `throttler/status`, `auth/refresh-token` |

Nothing was committed, pushed or deployed, and no production database or environment variable was touched. The two new migrations of this session (`20261029090000_learner_feedback.sql`; the earlier two are listed in §3) were applied only to the local test database and to a throwaway local database through the hardened runner.

## 7. Session 3 (2026-10-29): the admin console (batches A–I)

Classification of every admin route: `docs/ADMIN_INTEGRATION_MATRIX.md`, generated by `node scripts/classify-admin-routes.cjs`.

### Admin route counts (169 admin routes)

| Category | Routes |
|---|---|
| Integrated | **122** |
| Integrated through an equivalent route | **13** |
| Partially integrated: admin password recovery by email (2), legacy `/files` store (2) | **4** |
| Deliberately not offered: server refuses (freeze, delete, subscription changes) or the effect isn't real (settings edits) | **7** |
| Unintegrated: disconnected silos awaiting your decision (`/admin/questions` 7, `/admin/courses` 7, `/admin/roles` + `/admin/permissions` 8) | **22** |
| Intentionally server-only (`POST /admin/auth/refresh`) | **1** |

Previously 131 admin routes were unintegrated. Two admin routes were added: `GET /admin/access` and `GET /questions/manage/all`.

### Backend problems found and fixed (all local; no schema changes)

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| **`GET /admin/users/:id/progress` and `/analytics` returned fixed values** ("0%", zero XP) | Counted from the learner's records: enrollments, lessons, official and own attempts, personal courses, generated resources, materials, XP, coins, streaks, timed study hours |
| **Admin notifications never reached learners.** They were stored only in `admin_notifications`, while the API answered "sent successfully" | Delivered into the learners' `notifications` (type `system`). Broadcasts go to real audiences (everyone, secondary, university, one institution, one department; deleted and frozen accounts are skipped) in one statement, with the delivered count reported. "Premium users" answers 501 (no subscriptions). Title ≤150 and message ≤2,000 characters are enforced |
| **Subscription "refund" marked a record EXPIRED and answered "refunded"** with no payment involved; update and cancel acted on a table nothing reads | Update, cancel and refund answer **501** (no live subscription or payment provider). Reads stay |
| **User actions (suspend, verify, reset password) didn't record which admin acted** | Also written to the audit log (`admin_activity_logs`) with the admin id. The action itself never fails because of the audit write |
| **XP and coin adjustments had no audit category and logged a made-up IP** (`127.0.0.1`) | Category `GAMIFICATION`; no invented IP |
| **CSV exports could carry spreadsheet formulas** (a learner named `=HYPERLINK(…)`) | Cells starting with `= + - @` are neutralised |
| **`PATCH /questions/:id` passed the raw body to `update`**, so an `id` in the body could rewrite the primary key | Protected fields are stripped (create and update) |
| The `roles`/`permissions` tables look like RBAC but **aren't used for authorization** | Not wired. New read-only `GET /admin/access` (`roles.manage`) shows the enforced role → permission map and the admin accounts (no secrets) |
| The question bank had no admin read (learner and admin tokens are separate) | `GET /questions/manage/all` (`content.manage`): search, subject and exam filters, paging |

### Console structure (ten navigation groups)

| Group | Pages and tabs |
|---|---|
| Overview | Needs attention (pending reports, pending AI content, restricted accounts, from the real lists); exact counts; system health; recent admin activity; quick links to every section the role can use |
| Users & academics | **Users** (list, search; detail adds a **learning overview**, **reset password**, **adjust XP/coins** with a reason, **message this learner**; all confirmed and audited). **School directory** (institutions, faculties, departments; academic levels read-only) |
| Learning content | Courses & lessons (existing, `/admin/content`) |
| Assessments & questions | Quizzes, tests & exams (existing). **Question bank**: the shared `questions` table (create, edit, delete with confirmation; learners see changes immediately) plus a "Reported by learners" tab |
| AI & moderation | Reports (now with details and notes: `GET`/`PATCH /admin/reports/:id`), Feedback, AI content (full record: `GET /admin/ai/generated-content/:id`); tabs linkable by `?tab=` |
| Gamification | Overview (real XP, coin and streak totals), Leaderboard (linked to learners), Adjustments (from the audit log) |
| Subscriptions & finance | Revenue, Subscriptions (records, read-only), Payments & refunds: each shows the server's answer, which is "not available yet" |
| Reports & analytics | Platform (accounts real; engagement, sign-ins and learning totals unavailable), Detailed reports (10 sections, all "not available yet"), **Export centre** (users, account totals, admin activity as CSV or JSON; transactions unavailable) |
| Security & administration | Restricted accounts, Security events, Audit log (expand for the full record), Activity, Roles & access (enforced matrix and admin accounts) |
| System & configuration | System health (live) and Monitors (unavailable), **Notifications** (one learner or an audience, confirmed, with history), Platform settings (read-only) |

Tabs and sections are hidden when the role lacks the permission. The backend enforces every permission regardless; the default-deny spec covers the two new routes.

### Database

No new migrations in this session, and no schema changes. Everything used existing tables, in the local test database only. The earlier local-only migrations, including `20261029090000_learner_feedback.sql`, were not run anywhere else. `DB_SYNCHRONIZE=false` is unchanged.

### Decisions needed

1. **`/admin/questions` (`admin_questions`):** recommend retiring the routes after checking whether production holds rows there. If it does, migrate them into `questions` with a reviewed migration. Nothing was deleted.
2. **`/admin/courses` (`admin_courses`):** the same situation; the real catalogue is `/admin/content`.
3. **`/admin/roles` + `/admin/permissions`:** either remove them, or make authorization read them, which is a security-sensitive change needing design and review.
4. **Admin account management** (create admins, change roles): not offered; it needs your approval.
5. **Privacy controls and public profiles:** unchanged (unavailable and unlinked), as instructed.
6. **Legacy learner routes (36):** still classified as superseded; nothing retired.
